subject: English
question_text: Read the passage carefully and complete the table below
stimulus: with information from the passage. 1×5=5 Stephen Hawking is considered the greatest physist after Einstein. He was born in England in 1942. He was very skilled in mathematics from the early age. He wrote the book 'A brief History of Time : from the Big Bang to the present times in 1988. In this book he explains cosmology for the general public. It became famous and established his reputation as a great scientist. He received his Ph. D. in cosmology from Cambridge University in 1968. But fortune did not favour him. In 1972 he became a victim of Gehrig's disease. Since then, he has been confirmed to a wheelchair with no power to control his body. But he continues teaching through the help of computer. In 1974, he won the prsstigious Albert Einstein Award for theoretical physics. In 1979, he joined Cambridge University as a Lucasian profession of Mathematics. He is still carrying out his research work using his computer. Name of the events Year/ Place Achievement time Born (i) ..... (ii) ..... in 1988 Became Lucasian (iii) ..... professor of Mathematics
guide_solution: Information transfer (i) In 1942; (ii) Wrote the book "A Brief History of Time"; (iii) Cambridge University; (iv) In 1968; (v) Won the prestigious Albert Ainstein Award
